summary: A free, monthly meetup for real estate agents hosted by Cory Wall Real Estate at 216 Asheland Ave, Asheville, branded 'AHA Club' with a goal-setting/peer-support format ('Write It. Carry It. Live It.' / 'See it. Believe it. Build it — together.'). The 'Agents Only' and 'Support Groups' tags and the recurring club identity suggest it could be a real peer network of local agents, but only two listings exist and both are generic Eventbrite copy with no named regulars, membership sign-up, dues, or social presence to confirm a returning core.

evidence.note: December listing is framed as an ongoing club ('Join us at AHA Club this month!') rather than a one-off class, with tags Agents Only and Support Groups alongside Networking/Professional Development.

January listing is a goal-setting workshop combining 'guided planning exercises, accountability tools, and peer networking,' consistent with a recurring peer group rather than a single commercial class.
Both events are organized solely by Cory Wall Real Estate at the same address; no other host, member list, or named regulars appear in either listing.
Cory Wall Real Estate's own site (301-redirected from corywallrealestate.com) returned 403 Forbidden, so it could not be checked for club details.

Searches for 'Agents Helping Agents Club' / 'AHA Club' plus Asheville or Cory Wall turned up no Facebook group/page, Meetup, Instagram, or news coverage — no independent web presence exists beyond the two Eventbrite listings.
